'''Dochinie''' were avian creatures indigenous to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Qina/Legends|Qina]]. At commands from a wind pipe by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] natives, dochinie would herd [[pech]]s and [[rujo]]s.<ref name="Gamer 9" />
